source: his 2026-10-26 11:24: "right a Jaeger like quest idea. Missonboard. Our outpost is being attack by Ashta. Only spawns on a outpost on Cheyenne"
_note: THE FIRST JAEGER DELVE. An outpost on Cheyenne is under attack by Ashta, the planet's own predators. Sound the
alarm, then hold through three waves. 16a's shape (a use, then a hold defending it), which played on the industrial ten.
JAEGER'S FRAME, kept light (office/stories/2026-07-31-jaeger-frame-spec.md, frame 01, the territorial native): the
Ashta were hunting this ground before the outpost went up. Said once, by the client, as a fact about the ground.
The July owed fix holds: no interiority for the animal, nobody says what it wants.
TWO THINGS NOT BUILT, the lint refuses or ignores each, Eliza's:
(1) CHEYENNE ONLY. A planet condition on a board's request. Not the second-request planet guard that crashed 10a and
12a, but the same family, so price it before it goes near the plugin. Stand-in field: place.planet.
(2) ASHTA WAVES. A hold's waves come from the base driver's gang list (spacers). This wants a creature list, Ashta
only: hold.list is the stand-in. Which LeveledNpc is Ashta is hers to find.
Ashta is not said aloud: voiced lines name roles only. The card and objectives say it.

place._theme: A non-hostile built site: somebody's outpost. His word is outpost; whether a request on Cheyenne can place one is the pool question.
place._planet: STAND-IN for his 'Only spawns on a outpost on Cheyenne'. Not a field yet.

prose.name: Defense: Ashta at the <Place> on <Planet>
prose.briefing: An Ashta pack has been hitting the <Place> for days, and the people there can't hold them off alone.
prose.card: Defense contract. Ashta have been attacking our outpost on <Planet>, and we can't hold them off on our own. Sound the alarm and help us see the next attack through. Payment on contract completion.

beats.journal: The Ashta have been circling the <Place> for days. I sounded the alarm, and everyone there got behind a wall.
beats.name: Outpost Alarm
beats._model: The field terminal, approved, as 16a. A siren or a floodlight mast would say it better; Kim's shelf.
say: They'll have heard it too. They always come when it goes off.

beats.journal: The Ashta came at the <Place> three times and didn't get in. Whatever's left of the pack has gone back out into the grass.
beats._list: STAND-IN: an Ashta-only creature list, Eliza's. Size per side on the horde (his rule).
say: That's them gone. Back out into the grass.
They were hunting here long before we came. I don't think they've forgotten it.

broadcast: You're here? Good. Get the alarm going so everyone gets inside.
They come in from the long grass, and they come fast.
Don't let them reach the middle of the camp.
_speech: The outpost's lead, steady, has done this before. Sarah (Mature, Reassuring, Confident), in two recipes; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency, and the animal is never named aloud.
